name: Arc Engine
description: WO-P5-12 — THE COMPUTE GATE. The Arc Engine (System 2 / Oracle Function) shipped as an installed mod. Its state lives in a mod-declared table (mod.arc.arcs); its tick runs as a post-turn compute track inside the track registry; its surface line is a prompt contribution. Uninstall it and the app still runs — Arc's prompt contribution simply is not there. The host-side ArcInjectorButton and chapter-tab rendering stay in the app until PANELS/SCREENS (this is the COMPUTE gate, not the project gate).
